blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former President Rodrigo Duterte’s defense has asked the International Criminal Court (ICC) to strike out eight additional killing incidents included by prosecutors in their trial brief, arguing that their inclusion improperly expands the crimes against humanity charges confirmed for trial.
